tooltips.smSharePercent: Percentage of shift gross paid to a user assigned this role. If several roles are assigned, the highest percentage is used.
tooltips.smShiftPreparePermission: Requires shift create/edit ACL. All records permits any readable team.
tooltips.smShiftOperatePermission: Requires shift edit ACL. Own shifts means the operator slot, regardless of account type.
tooltips.smShiftRevisePermission: Requires shift edit ACL. Own production means teams produced by this user.
tooltips.smStaffAccessPermission: Requires staff tab and User read ACL. Own production means teams produced by this user.
tooltips.smAnalyticsAccessPermission: Requires Analytics tab ACL. Own shifts includes model/operator/producer participation.
tooltips.smInvitationsPermission: Sensitive: together with link CRUD ACL, allows inviting with any role, including elevated roles.
